text: Drive up Twin Lakes Road (FS-3065) to the trailhead between the two lakes. The final two and a half miles are rough and one-lane in places; high clearance is recommended and four-wheel drive helps, though it isn't strictly required. Drive Canyon Creek Road (FS-31) north off SR-542 just east of Glacier, then FS-3160 to its end at about 4,800 ft. The upper road is single-lane and rough, high clearance is the usual advice, and the parking is no more than a wide spot at the end.

pins.name: Hozomeen Campground / Hozomeen Lake Trailhead (upper loop)

text: From Trans-Canada Highway 1 just west of Hope, B.C., take Exit 168 to Flood Hope Road and turn onto the Silver Skagit Road, following it about 36 miles (58 km) south to its end at the border and the Hozomeen ranger station and campground at the head of Ross Lake. The border gate there has been closed to vehicles and walkers; confirm it is open before planning on this drive.

pins.name: Depot Creek Road turnout, Chilliwack Lake Road

text: This one starts on the Canadian side. Drive Chilliwack Lake Road in BC and park at the large turnout about 0.1 mi before the yellow steel bridge over Depot Creek, around 2,040 ft; Depot Creek Road leaves here as an unsigned dirt spur. Access is from the Canadian side, off the Chilliwack River Road. Turn onto Depot Creek Road, a rough dirt spur that has been washed out in places, and drive it to where the washout ends vehicle travel at roughly 2,600 feet; high clearance helps, and it is best driven from mid-summer through early fall.
